chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 430: The Narrowing Noose – Ji Ning vs the Pixiu Formation & Mu Northson Reunion
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning battles four Pixiu divine beasts to rescue his traumatized junior brother Mu Northson. A grudge match erupts when the General refuses to negotiate.
og_title: The Narrowing Noose: Ji Ning Faces a Binding Trap and a Shattered Junior Brother
og_description: A full-scale siege unfolds as Ji Ning’s search for Mu Northson ends in a violent confrontation. Pixiu beasts, a silver-armored General, and the shattering return of a lost brother.
twitter_title: Ji Ning vs the Pixiu Beasts: Rescue Mission Explodes into War
twitter_description: The reunion is not a happy one. Ji Ning deploys his entire arsenal, including his Primaltwin, to break through a divine formation and find his broken junior brother.

lore_anchors.definition: A divine beast from Chinese mythology, the Pixiu is one of the nine legendary sons of the Ancestor Dragon. In Desolate Era, it is conjured as a formation by Bronze Demon Guards, transforming nine soldiers into a single powerful war-beast.
In the novel's cosmology, the first dragon born from the primordial chaos, even older than Torch Dragon. She is the mother of all dragons and gave birth to nine divine sons, including the Pixiu.

In Desolate Era, binding-type treasures (like ropes or nets) are a specific counter to forms of invulnerability such as the Eight-Nine Arcane Art. They restrict movement and prevent the use of escape talismans, representing a tactical vulnerability for otherwise indestructible cultivators.

A second body created by a Ki Refiner at the Primal Daoist stage, sharing the same soul and consciousness. Ji Ning’s Primaltwin can act independently and, when working in tandem with his true body, can control hundreds of flying swords as if by a single mind.

Ji Ning’s signature sword formation, an upgraded version of the Lesser Thousand Sword Formation. At the fourth level, it synchronizes over 300 flying swords to deliver a devastating, single-strike attack.

A supreme divine ability beneath the True God level that grants a cultivator an indestructible body, immune to most forms of attack. Its primary weakness is binding-type treasures that can immobilize the user.

One of the top ten divine abilities of the Three Realms, created by Daoist Threelives. It allows the user to temper their hands into devastating weapons, capable of matching Pure Yang treasures in power.
